niche_statement: Connected-hardware and medical-device companies at the moment their product's mobile companion app becomes the bottleneck — a BLE-device app that won't ship, a legacy iOS/Android codebase aging past OS and app-store deadlines, or a first companion app with no one aboard who has shipped regulated mobile — served by a 30-year bare-metal-C-to-SwiftUI engineer who has shipped BLE medical apps, NIH-funded clinical data-collection suites, and solo App Store submissions.
edp: A connected device whose companion app misses a platform deadline (Google Play target-API delisting, Apple SDK rejection) or fails store review stops selling entirely — every unit in the channel needs the app to activate, so 100% of new-device revenue freezes until the app ships.
expertise_statements: Modernize our aging Objective-C companion app to Swift/SwiftUI without halting feature releases
Build an iOS and Android app that pairs reliably with our Bluetooth Low Energy sensor
Migrate a legacy Android tablet app across many OS versions to meet Play Store target API requirements
First mobile hire to own our hardware product's companion app end to end, architecture through App Store submission
Develop mobile software for a Class II medical device under IEC 62304 and ISO 13485
Build a cross-platform Xamarin / .NET MAUI app with iOS as the primary target for a medical device
Create a mobile data-collection app for an IRB-approved, grant-funded clinical research study
Take our prototype app through App Store review and manage the submission and release process
Rescue an inherited mobile codebase after the original agency or developer left, with no documentation
Ship a companion app for a connected home appliance or consumer IoT device
Stabilize a mobile app for an emergency-alerting or public-safety platform with geofencing and push notifications
Stand up a small mobile team and bring PMP-grade schedule discipline to a slipping hardware-plus-app program
Prototype locally hosted LLM features (Ollama, RAG, vector search) inside an existing product
Accelerate compute-heavy image processing or simulation workloads with CUDA on GPUs
Bridge firmware and mobile teams so device data collection, eventbus messaging, and BLE protocols actually integrate
Deliver desktop and tablet data-collection tools in C#/WPF alongside the mobile app for a robotics platform
disqualifiers: web-only SaaS with no hardware or mobile product
React Native-only or Flutter-only codebase (his cross-platform depth is Cordova/Xamarin/native, not RN/Flutter)
staffing agency or offshore dev-shop postings on behalf of unnamed clients
pure backend, data-platform, or SRE roles with no mobile or device surface
